About

Ph.D. candidate in Civil & Environmental Engineering at Florida International University, advised by Dr. Wallied Orabi. Research spans flood resilience, multi-hazard digital twins, multi-resolution risk modeling, and bridge infrastructure condition assessment. Interdisciplinary background combining structural QA, transportation simulation, and GIS-driven community resilience frameworks.
